name: Kikan College
description: Kikan College is a block theme for a plumbing and heating apprenticeship college for adults: a two-year course, one year at the bench and one year placed with a working firm. The home page opens on a rounded framed window with a navy panel, vertical labels, a copper slash and a low-key photograph, then a stats row, tinted tiles with white plates, a proportional day strip, the two years, a parallax hall band, placements, instructors, apprentice stories, a fee table and a taster Saturday band. Copy and photography are the college's own; quiet navy and cool grey with one copper accent.
